preservation_command:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from blinker import Signal
signal = Signal()
def receiver(sender):
    return "ok"
signal.connect(receiver, weak=False)
assert signal.send("sender") == [(receiver, "ok")]
signal.disconnect(receiver)
assert signal.send("sender") == []
